note: Resort on Big Manistique Lake near Curtis (D&K Log Cabin Resort & Campground, LLC; new owners Dave and Kris Lee): full-hookup pull-thru and back-in sites, water/electric and electric-only sites, some seasonal sites, plus 14 cabins. Swimming beach, marina with boat slips (boats 22 ft or less), pontoon and kayak rentals. The office is unsigned: the first building past the owners' campers on the right of the driveway. Use phone 906-287-0799 (aggregator 906-586-9732 is stale). --Claude
